sections.voiceover: However, OpenAI GPT-6 Astra scored 100% and swept all four identical professional builds.

sections.voiceover: On the Intelligence Index, OpenAI GPT-6 Astra leads 52 points to 50. Yet Google Gemini 4 Argon won 14 of 19 launch benchmark tests. Astra took 200 seconds, but Gemini finished in 135 seconds.
